conceptZh: 自以為隱形的布忍者輕輕碰倒一塊小方塊，連鎖倒下的軟積木剛好排成「兔」，躲在後面的小兔子被抓包。
object: a tiny felt ninja with a black mask and a red headband, a row of soft pink felt blocks, and a small white plush bunny
morph: a chain of tumbling pink felt blocks lands as the glyph 兔 while a plush bunny hops out from behind it
creativeAngle: 骨牌效應：布忍者躲不好還以為沒人看見，一碰倒積木鏈，倒成「兔」，藏在後面的小兔子現形；詞「兔子」靠小兔子跳出來呼應。
promptEn: An 8-second whimsical clip on a clean solid pale sky-blue backdrop with one large Traditional Chinese glyph 兔 as the only text in frame, made of thick soft pink felt strokes with a gloss-free matte look but strongly saturated magenta-pink color, about 70% of frame height, centered and uncropped. Lead: a tiny felt ninja in a black mask and red headband, spectacularly bad at hiding and certain no one can see him; one supporting character, a small white plush bunny. No background music, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Voice: warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin saying exactly 兔、兔、兔子 (ㄊㄨˋ、ㄊㄨˋ、ㄊㄨˋ ㄗ˙), slowly with clear tones, then silence. Moment 1 (0–1.7s): the ninja tiptoes in sideways with exaggerated knee lifts, freezes behind a tiny rock that is only half his size with his bright red headband sticking out, and as the first 兔 is spoken he flicks a soft pink felt block, tick, starting a chain. Moment 2 (1.7–3.4s): the blocks tumble in a rolling flop-flop wave across the floor and the ninja hurries after them, trying to catch the last block with both hands, tripping over his own tiny sandal and rolling into a ball. Moment 3 (3.4–5s): the second 兔 lands as the felt blocks settle in the shape of 兔: a slanted top stroke, a boxy body with an inner cross, a long falling left stroke, and a little dot like a cotton tail at the lower right. The ninja springs up, bows triumphantly. Moment 4 (5s): as 兔子 is spoken, a white plush bunny pops up from behind the glyph's own big belly gap, ears flopping, and the ninja spins around, freezes with wide eyes, then slowly holds a finger to his lips. Final 5–8s: the glyph 兔 stays totally still and sharp while the ninja, off to one side, pretends to be a bush, swaying with the bunny leaning into his shoulder; no contact with the strokes. Soft daylight, no flashing, no real people, no other writing anywhere.

conceptZh: 小外星人想用牽引光束抓一疊胡蘿蔔積木，卻把自己的飛碟吸到彈射板上，倒數三秒後被彈飛，越過目標、撞牆反彈、倒栽進水桶，被撞散的胡蘿蔔積木剛好落成橘色的「兔」，小兔子跳出來啃走最後一根。
object: a wobbly stack of chunky carrot-orange toy blocks beside a tin bucket, with a plank-style toy catapult
morph: the alien is launched off the catapult, overshoots the carrot stack, bounces off the far wall and lands upside-down in the bucket; the orange blocks knocked loose by the pass tumble and settle into the strokes of 兔
creativeAngle: 相較前一版「忍者推倒積木」的靜態連鎖，這版改成大弧線彈射的實體笨拙喜劇：外星人的牽引光束抓錯自己是角色專屬笑點，彈飛、撞牆、倒栽水桶三個大動作每 1.5 秒換一個新畫面，橘色胡蘿蔔積木落成「兔」把字形跟兔子吃的食物綁在一起，而「兔子」一詞由真的小兔跳出來啃胡蘿蔔來對應。
promptEn:
An 8-second cartoon clip on a clean, solid pale mint-cream backdrop. The only text ever on screen is one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 兔, built from chunky matte carrot-orange toy blocks, saturated orange against the light background, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height when finished. Lead: a small round green cartoon alien with one big eye and two bouncy antennae, piloting a silver toy flying saucer; it is greedy, overconfident and its purple tractor beam always grabs the wrong thing. Props: a wobbly stack of orange carrot-shaped blocks at frame right, a plank-and-pivot toy catapult at frame left, a small tin bucket at the far right edge. No music, no subtitles, no other writing, no real people.

Voice: a warm, friendly off-screen narrator in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 兔、兔、兔子 (ㄊㄨˋ、ㄊㄨˋ、ㄊㄨˋ ˙ㄗ), slowly, every syllable distinct with clear tones, then silence.

Moment 1 (0–1.5s): the saucer hovers at left, the alien rubs its hands and points at the carrot stack. It fires the tractor beam; the beam curls back like a hose, lifts its own saucer into the air, and drops alien and saucer with a clunk onto the catapult plank. The first 兔 is spoken as it lands there, antennae boinging.

Moment 2 (1.5–3s): the alien stands tall on the plank, strikes a drumroll pose, counts down on three green fingers, then stomps the far end. BOING: the plank flings it skyward and it sails across the whole frame in a huge slow arc, arms out, eye wide with glee.

Moment 3 (3–4.8s): it whooshes right past the carrot stack, its trailing antenna flicking the top block so the whole stack wobbles and spills, smacks flat against the far right wall with a cartoon squash, peels off and drops upside-down into the bucket, little green feet kicking. The spilled orange blocks tumble inward and settle into the glyph 兔: a short slanted stroke at the top left, a hooked box for the head, a square body beneath it, two legs below (a sweeping left leg and a right leg with an upturned hook), and a single dot tucked at the lower right like a cotton tail. The second 兔 is spoken exactly as the last block, the dot, clicks into place.

Moment 4 (4.8–8s): the glyph 兔 holds perfectly still, sharp and centered. At about 5.5s the word 兔子 is spoken as a small white plush bunny with long floppy ears hops in beside the bucket, picks up one leftover carrot block and nibbles it, ears twitching. The alien pops its head out of the bucket wearing it like a helmet, dizzy spiral eye, big grin, and waves a tiny wave at the bunny, both staying clear of the strokes to the bottom right. Soft even daylight, bright but not neon, no flashing, nobody hurt.
